summary: Configured persistent inventory log forwarding from node2 to node1 over TCP. Messages are stored at /var/log/inventory/node2.log. Verified delivery before restarts and after independently restarting both nodes.
actions_performed: Configured node1 rsyslog to listen on 10.100.92.10:514/TCP and persist inventory messages received from node2.
Added a persistent firewalld rule allowing TCP/514 only from node2.
Configured node2 rsyslog with durable queued forwarding for messages tagged inventory.
Validated both rsyslog configurations and confirmed live end-to-end delivery.
Restarted node1 and node2 sequentially, confirming changed boot IDs and full logging recovery after each restart.
